name: Project Nightfall

features.text: UV-sensitive infected types, sun damage, hibernation, shelter/evasion and Feral reserve/sprinting.
Smart stalking/ambush, screech response, personal hordes and persistent Alpha leadership/territory.
Seasonal movement, shelters/dens, lighting defense and bounded crowd behavior.
Provenance-checked body-part effigies and feeding; research files and configurable presets.

Five-category effigy policy and a separate real EffigyFrame prototype: permanently closed native insertion, synchronous server-owned actual-item loading, batch/replay/access/capacity checks, compensation/quarantine, and localized source-aware intent menu. Native unloading retained; three states derived from physical contents.
EffigyFrame loot distribution, non-feeding influence/attribution, legacy migration and three EMPTY/MEAT_LOADED/BODY_PART_LOADED production models/rendering remain planned.

Human dedicated validation of prototype guards, competing transfers, packet routing, save/reload, rejoin, controller/menu and failure recovery remains blocked pending runtime evidence. The unsafe dynamic native predicate is replaced in source by permanently denied native insertion.
Server-authoritative UV infected policy using MORTIS services: starvation-gated Feral/Smart/Alpha lifecycles, hibernation/rise, bounded regional tissue work and intelligent groups/ecology.
Transactional effigy food provider with reserve/commit/rollback and post-success world cleanup; native persistence and transport remain unverified.
Own-owner cleanup before identity/phase commit, retryable UV release, checked assignment compensation and a retained server recovery journal. Unknown outcomes remain blocked for review.

Dependency diagnostics separate API surface from source capability readiness. MORTIS API 1.6/food transaction v1 retained; pinned Knowledge 0.17.0 private documents support fresh dedicated lives in source, broader guards remain blocked.
Read-only localized selected-corpse remains-condition UI; sandbox/presets, research content and bounded diagnostics. SPXTRM retains the lightWorks Lua namespace.
Native smoke/anatomical presentation and loot-preserving visible remains after safe adapters, plus human balance/audio validation.
Human SP/dedicated lifecycle, owner/restoration, observer/late join and save/restart acceptance. Native packaging/release gates remain separate; no runtime proof from CI.

Reusable EffigyFrame feeding reads actual stored items through a server MORTIS transaction-v1 provider. Shared load/feed lease, exact item/material/revision checks, compensation/quarantine, pending-intent recovery block, bounded loaded discovery, native same-ID stock updates and chunk-save requests; frame and depleted part items survive. Ordinary meat has no part-specific reactions.

Research-gated reusable-frame assembly and actual-item placement through server-only commands. Configurable log/large-branch/rope/nail costs; working hammer/sharp knife and Base.HandDrill retained unchanged, exact inventory IDs, native world publication, safehouse/floor/reach checks, shared frame lease and server GlobalModData recovery guards. Context UI sends intent only; blocked dedicated Knowledge storage fails closed.

Original user-supplied Nightfall/UV artwork preserved in the source poster; an approved deterministic 512-square preview derivative is prepared for Workshop. Separate icon retained; native display and Workshop acceptance NOT TESTED.

Workshop packaging rejects canonical or serialized descriptions at the SDK UTF-8 byte limit before artifact mutation. Shortened publication text retains features, credits and explicit MP/research limitations; unpublished dev.5 artifacts preserved.

Dedicated effigy research selects pinned Knowledge 0.17.0 private document storage for fresh test worlds/server-created lives; real API gates assembly/placement. Diagnostics separate structural private document support from broader blocked guards and client presentation; initialized storage/character readiness remain unprobed. Existing-world migration/failure cases remain closed.

Paired MORTIS global hunger FIFO/budget (default 32, server integer 1–512), elapsed-time catch-up/pre-meal settlement, idle-AI hunger query avoidance, 128-entry legacy discovery ceiling and authority-local queue diagnostics. Offline 100,000-actor work counts; native Insane-population timing NOT TESTED.

Matching Knowledge 0.17.0 / MORTIS 0.26.0-dev.9 / Nightfall 0.31.0-dev.8 Workshop uploads verified through cached-account SteamCMD in dependency order. Public metadata matches for MORTIS/Nightfall; Knowledge anonymous page unavailable. Distribution is not native dedicated proof.

User-approved transparent infected-only mod-list icon replaces the prior icon. Exact RGBA master/prompt retained; thumbnail/poster and gameplay/dependency contracts unchanged. Native mod-list display NOT TESTED.

limits: Development 0.31.0-dev.9 is a presentation-only icon iteration over published dev.8 gameplay. Knowledge 0.17.0 / MORTIS 0.26.0-dev.9 pins retained. Fresh-world research only; existing-world migration, broader Knowledge guards, effigy model/rendering, non-feeding influence and other recorded native acceptance remain blocked. Native icon display, SP/dedicated and Insane-population timing NOT TESTED; G7/stable G8 BLOCKED. Dev.8 packages/receipts and earlier build-set inventory remain historical. No server launch or local deployment.
